The first 1.1 beta brings **notifications**. Flytower can tell you about failed backups and off-site copies, the disk filling up, new versions, servers starting and stopping, and players joining and leaving. It sends them to Discord, ntfy or signed JSON webhooks, with quiet periods and retries. Set up channels on the System page.

Every pull request now also gets a signed test build, which the installer can install with `--pr <number>`.
